back: A construct that chooses which statements to run by evaluating a Boolean condition.
IF condition THEN ... ELSE ... ENDIF; Python: if / elif / else with a colon and indentation.
CASE OF expression, branches value : statement, OTHERWISE for the default, ENDCASE. Python: match / case.
CASE for one expression against fixed values (menus, codes); IF for ranges, several variables and compound conditions.
Inside a range: x >= low AND x <= high. Outside a range: x < low OR x > high.
NOT (A AND B) = (NOT A) OR (NOT B); NOT (A OR B) = (NOT A) AND (NOT B).
In an if/elif chain the first true condition runs and the rest are skipped, so test the most restrictive condition first.
= assigns and == compares. In pseudocode = tests equality inside a condition and the arrow assigns.
Normal data, every boundary value (on each side of the limit) and abnormal data that should be rejected.
